engine_dependency_audit_2026-10-09.source: read-only code audit of the production path (file:line refs in the summary below)
engine_dependency_audit_2026-10-09.summary: production reacts to only two personnel signals: who is ruled OUT and depth-chart order. Club volume, team scoring, efficiency, DST and kicker are built from club history and are QB-, OL-, opponent- and weather-blind. An OUT player's opportunity is re-normalised PRO RATA across the whole club (all position groups) by remaining claims x P(plays) (proj_v1.allocate_opportunity :773-951); redistribution.py is documentation only.

by_circumstance.QB change: PARTIAL -- new starter takes the attempts on his own pass prior; team volume, scoring, receiver efficiency, opposing DST, kicker QB-blind (proj_v1.py:167-273; football_points.py:69-84)
by_circumstance.RB out / WR out: IMPLEMENTED pro rata club-wide (not role-aware; carries can flow to QB; no goal-line handling)
by_circumstance.multiple OL out: MISSING (OL inactives dropped as unpriced: showdown_slate_state.py:337-350)
by_circumstance.returning from injury: PARTIAL -- full chart rank and role, no ramp or snap limit
by_circumstance.backup becomes starter: IMPLEMENTED via depth rank (higher ceiling/appearance; own claim does not scale)
by_circumstance.Limited / QUESTIONABLE / DOUBTFUL: MISSING -- full projection; DOUBTFUL is NOT absent (availability.py:115-116); practice status displayed only
by_circumstance.multiple injuries: mechanically re-normalised; no depleted-offense volume or efficiency penalty
by_circumstance.weather / roof: MISSING (carried, never read; weather not captured)
by_circumstance.opponent defensive strength: MISSING for volume and efficiency (football_points.py OPPONENT_ADJUSTMENT NOT_MODELLED)

engine_dependency_audit_2026-10-09.suspected_defect: role_state._position_scoped_ranks (role_state.py:125-152) re-ranks absent players too: an OUT RB1 and his replacement can both carry depth_rank 1, tie broken by dk_id; if the replacement loses he gets the SECONDARY ceiling. Allocator unaffected (absent rows never reach it); role-band ceiling affected. No test. TO VERIFY with a failing test before any fix.
